title: Verify pi live: unattended flag, model substitution, effort suffix, resume
description:
Answer, by running it, what pi actually does — so a later tick can write a row
it has evidence for. This tick lands NO config. It produces findings.

It is deliberately unblocked and deliberately attended: the whole point is to
make pi usable as a worker EARLY, and the work that makes pi usable cannot be
given to pi. Run it at a terminal, by hand.

State today, verified 2026-09-10 by exercising Compile directly with kind "pi":
- A provider-qualified cloudflare id compiles and yields
  `--model cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3:high`. Effort is a SUFFIX
  for pi, not a flag.
- Every compile warns: `kind "pi" has no verified full-auto template in
  herdr-kinds.md; starting without one.` A WARNING, not a refusal — so a role
  routed to pi starts and may simply stall on a permission prompt.
- The pi row (ticks `internal/herd/config/kinds.go`) has fullAuto nil,
  fullAutoVerified false, and its comment records that the row was read from
  `pi --help` only.
- Local pi is 0.85.1; `pi auth check --provider cloudflare-workers-ai` reports
  ready with an api_key; `pi --list-models` lists 18 cloudflare-workers-ai
  models.

FOUR QUESTIONS TO ANSWER, each with the command run and the output seen:

1. What is pi's real unattended story? Read `pi --help` and its docs for the
   flag or config that suppresses approval prompts. Do not transcribe another
   kind's shape.

2. Does pi SILENTLY SUBSTITUTE an unknown model? This is the one that decides
   whether a tier means anything. opencode was caught running a whole turn on
   its own default after `--model openai/gpt-9-imaginary`, passing the
   first-round-trip gate with a clean OK, with only the pane footer betraying it
   (herdr-kinds.md, observed 2026-08-13). Run pi with a deliberately bad id and
   record whether it refuses, errors visibly, or falls back. `pi models` reports
   the session's current model in-band and may be the read-back that catches it.

3. Does the effort suffix break on a model with no thinking dimension? The
   catalog's `thinking` column is per model and several cloudflare entries are
   `no`. Append a level to one and record what happens.

4. Does the round trip hold end to end? Follow herdr-kinds.md "Adding a kind":
   create a WORKSPACE (never `pane split --current`, which resolves to whatever
   the operator is looking at), `herdr agent start` with the candidate template,
   confirm the ECHOED argv rather than trusting the template, prompt with
   `--wait`, read the pane for the answer, record `herdr agent get` and the
   `agent_session`. Then verify resume: C-c (not `ctrl-c`, which errors
   `unsupported key`), restart in the SAME pane under a FRESH agent name,
   confirm the prior turn is present. Record `herdr integration status`.

Two notes from the opencode round trip that will bite here: verify pi is on the
INTERACTIVE shell's PATH (`zsh -i -c 'which pi'`), because herdr starts the
agent in a pane at an interactive prompt; and `herdr agent prompt --wait`
without `--until` matches idle|done|blocked and does not track turns, so an
already-working agent's current turn can satisfy the wait.

Clean up every pane and workspace created.

Output: a findings document in the RESULT file, concrete enough that tick sur
can write the row and its validators without running anything again.
notes: 2026-09-10 11:40 - runner-state: NOT dispatched to a worker — this tick is deliberately attended (the work that makes pi usable cannot be given to pi). The orchestrator runs it at the terminal.
acceptance_criteria: The RESULT file answers all four questions with the command run and the output seen: pi's real unattended flag or config; whether pi refuses, errors visibly, or silently substitutes on an unknown model id, with the read-back used to tell; what happens when an effort suffix is applied to a model whose catalog thinking column is 'no'; and a completed live round trip with the echoed argv, the agent_session, a confirmed resume after a C-c restart under a fresh agent name, and the integration status. Every pane and workspace created is cleaned up, verified by listing them afterwards. No config change lands in this tick.
